prompt: Single continuous shot, no cuts. Opens mid-action: a thick steak flipped in a cast-iron pan, flames licking up the side, violent sizzle. The camera follows to eggs cracking one-handed into a bowl, whisked fast, then rice steaming as a scoop lifts. Money shot: the sliced steak, deep pink center revealed cut by cut, laid over rice with the fried egg sliding on top, yolk catching warm backlight. Final beat: the loaded plate landing on the table with weight, fork driving in. Warm 3200K light, deep shadows, macro on the meat fibers, film grain. Dominant sound: the flame sear, then the knife through crust. No speech, no voice, no narration, no dialogue, no music.
